prompt: Summarize what was decided in the following meeting notes, in 2-3 sentences for the project record.
input_text: During the project kickoff meeting for Northwind Logistics' RFP response, it was decided to proceed with a three-phase rollout, starting with a discovery phase in April, followed by an earlier pilot at the Hai Phong depot in the first two weeks of May, to avoid conflicts with a seasonal peak. Mai Tran confirmed the allocation of two part-time coordinators for the pilot, while Tom Rasmussen addressed the requirement for an on-premise integration approach. Action items included revisions to the pilot schedule, documentation of the connector strategy, and planning for a finance committee review after the pilot results in June.
output_text: During the kickoff meeting for Northwind Logistics' RFP response, it was agreed to implement a three-phase rollout, initiating with a discovery phase in April, followed by a pilot at the Hai Phong depot in early May. Mai Tran confirmed the allocation of two part-time coordinators for the pilot, while Tom Rasmussen emphasized the need for an on-premise integration approach. Key action items included revising the pilot schedule, documenting the connector strategy, and planning a finance committee review following the pilot results in June.
